items.title: Crypto traders are in risk-on mode as bitcoin dominance nears return to 60%
items.summary: Bitcoin dominance is closing in on 60% while USDT's has slipped to 6.3%, pointing to a market growing more comfortable with risk.

items.title: Bitcoin open interest jumps $2.3 billion as traders pay more for bullish positions
items.summary: Rising open interest and funding rates signal renewed demand for bullish bitcoin exposure.

items.title: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there
items.summary: A Tether-backed project, Utexo, plans to support private USDT transfers, direct swaps between BTC and USDT and loans backed by BTC, while keeping most transaction data off Bitcoin’s public ledger.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $86,000 ahead of U.S. jobs report
items.summary: Bitcoin is up roughly 3% in October as traders await September’s jobs data, while rising bond yields, a stronger dollar weigh on broader markets.

items.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds
items.summary: The regulator issued a proposed rule for custody, marking a swan song for its inaugural Crypto Task Force chief, Commissioner Hester Peirce, who exits this week.
